visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long reddish-brown hair in a beige oversized t-shirt and shorts stands in a modern living room. Behind her, a tall man in a navy t-shirt and black shorts assists her in contorting their bodies to form the shapes of letters F, R, I, D, A, and Y. The setting features light grey curtains and a white marble floor under bright, even lighting. (2) The couple faces each other, the woman laughing joyfully while the man makes playful hand gestures. Red text reading HAPPY FRIDAY with animated white sparkles appears in the center of the frame. (3) The man performs a series of physical poses in the background as the woman sits on the floor in the foreground, watching him. He acts out characters like One Punch Man by punching the air and flexing. White comic-style text bubbles appear around him. (4) The man crouches and mimics a dinosaur with clawed hands and a shaking torso, acting out Jurassic World. The woman claps and laughs from her seated position on the floor. (5) The couple sits cross-legged on the floor facing each other. The man wears large white over-ear headphones while the woman speaks clearly, gesturing with her fingers for a lip-reading game. (6) A mobile screen recording displays the friDay Video app interface, showing movie posters and variety show thumbnails. (7) The woman holds a smartphone toward the camera, demonstrating the app's features while pointing at the screen. (8) A series of quick cuts show a child watching a tablet in a restaurant, a phone being held horizontally, and the couple watching a large TV at home. (9) The woman speaks enthusiastically to the camera as overlays of colorful mousepads with cartoon characters appear. (10) Further screen recordings show upcoming titles like Taxi Driver 3 and Spy x Family on the app UI. (11) The woman concludes by gesturing toward the camera while confetti graphics and text detailing a 360-day promotion and pricing appear.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy, fast-tempo electronic pop BGM featuring bright synth stabs and a driving drum machine beat. Two voices, one male and one female, shout the letters F-R-I-D-A-Y with high arousal and joyful valence. (2) A sharp laughter and a loud 'Happy Friday!' exclamation follow. The BGM continues with consistent intensity. (3) A high-pitched whistle SFX triggers as the scene shifts to a game. Fast-paced, playful dialogue between the man and woman ensues, characterized by high pitch variability and frequent rising intonations. (4) Distinct 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects punctuate each successful guess in the game, accompanied by subtle background laughter. (5) The BGM volume ducks slightly to allow for clear articulation as the woman speaks enunciated words for a lip-reading game, while the man's voice sounds muffled as if through headphones. (6) A digital 'swish' SFX transitions into the promotional segment. The woman’s voice becomes a professional, energetic narration. Interface clicking and scrolling sounds are layered with the upbeat BGM. (7) Background restaurant chatter and a faint child's voice are audible briefly beneath the main narration. (8) The video concludes with a swell in BGM volume and spectral brightness, finishing with a festive confetti pop SFX.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional advertisement for friDay Video's 10th anniversary. It uses a high-energy, comedic opening featuring games and character acting to engage the audience before transitioning into a detailed showcase of the app's content library and user-friendly features. It concludes with a strong call-to-action regarding a 'buy one year, get one year free' promotion.
